notes.body: hi @Lekensteyn and @AndersBroman. Could you please review this menu item description and make suggestions (if any) or approve/merge this request? Thanks
"wikipedia' is the name of a particular platform, "wiki" is the more accurate term. Additionally, it should probably link to this newer page: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/RLC-LTE

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1617/diffs?diff_id=134556859&start_sha=aa6b7865919ccb31605f06b536bd5e1989ae5d3a#c3d260f5e10c2a7adc987775268dcca104285a4d_95_95)
changed to "wiki" and refreshed the link - thanks.

The RLC graph is separate to the MAC and RLC stats.  There are some very out-of-date screenshots at https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/RLC-LTE.  I would suggest that you include that screenshot for now, and I can update it when I find time (I don't think there is an LTE RLC capture on the wiki).

I would describe it as follows:

"This menu item will launch a graph (similar to tcptrace) showing LTE Radio Link Control protocol sequence numbers changing over time along with acknowledgements received in the opposite direction.  Note that this is for a data of a single bearer and direction, and that these graphs may also be launched from the 'RLC Statistics' window."

hi. Could you please provide a newer data (some kind of data dump), that I could open with Wireshark and describe it in more details? Unfortunately, I don't have possibility to generate this data myself. Thanks in advance.
